verdict.rationale: A government IP office with a data portal could plausibly publish an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary, so this axis applies. The evidence pack shows no such specification. The documentation covers only filing procedures for trademarks, patents and designs, and the probe shows only that data.inpi.fr denies keyless access (HTTP 403) and requires an account-issued token. Nothing indicates a published machine-readable spec.
